direct_polynomial: The first ten formal-group tests and four cross tests establish the required integrality and congruences without the removed proxies; the direct integer polynomial then transfers modulo p^64.
geometric_compression: The conjugate-twist involution eliminates every nontrivial geometric endomorphism relation; the subgroup-closure proof and depth-one 3-adic nontorsion calculation are valid. The exact fixed-data checker was independently rerun. Pasten Corollary1.2 was checked in the primary paper.
denominator_obstructions: The argument was reviewed including constant predicates, simple-root lifts modulo p^2, real positivity, and valuation control at the new denominator prime. The requested explicit exclusion of rational scalar and coefficient denominator supports was incorporated. The subsequent extension to arbitrary finite Boolean combinations was also independently confirmed: negative denominator literals are preserved by real neighborhoods or one chosen local valuation neighborhood each.
scope: These reviews concern the stated new mathematical arguments. They do not independently certify the original manuscript's arithmetic assumptions, do not prove a definition with at most ten coordinates, and do not make the eighteen-parameter finite-decoding limitation a global lower bound for definitions of Z.
